capabilities: Rank dormant notes by relevance to the active note in an aging-pot sidebar
Blend two or more selected notes into a new AI-generated note without modifying originals
Notify at startup when notes reach a maturity threshold
Switch embedding providers between OpenAI and local Ollama, and blend providers between OpenAI and Anthropic
Manually re-index the vault to compute embeddings
extras: Documentation is largely in Japanese. Warning that API keys are stored as plain text in data.json. Embeddings are not recalculated on every edit; a manual vault re-index command is needed after adding or heavily editing notes.
problem: Old, untouched notes get forgotten, and there is no built-in way to rediscover them or combine them with current thinking when writing.

relations.evidence: OpenAI or local Ollama for embeddings (similarity search)
OpenAI or Claude (Anthropic) for blend generation
OpenAI or Claude (Anthropic) for blend generation

summary: AI plugin that resurfaces dormant notes similar to the note you are viewing and blends two or more selected notes into a new AI-generated idea note.
